title: MS Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution (PrintNightmare)
description: The Windows Print Spooler service allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges.
recommended_fix: Apply the security update referenced in Microsoft KB5004945 or disable the Print Spooler service on servers that do not require printing.

title: MS17-010: SMBv1 Remote Code Execution (EternalBlue)
description: The SMBv1 server on the remote host has multiple remote code execution vulnerabilities.
recommended_fix: Apply the MS17-010 patch and/or disable SMBv1 entirely; use SMBv2/v3 instead.

title: Windows MSHTML Platform Security Feature Bypass
description: A security feature bypass exists in the Windows MSHTML platform.
recommended_fix: Install the applicable Windows Update to address CVE-2024-30040.

title: Sudo Heap-Based Buffer Overflow (Baron Samedit)
description: A heap-based buffer overflow in sudo before 1.9.5p2 allows local privilege escalation to root.
recommended_fix: Upgrade sudo to version 1.9.5p2 or later via the distribution package manager.

title: OpenSSL Infinite Loop Denial of Service (BN_mod_sqrt)
description: OpenSSL's BN_mod_sqrt() function can be made to loop forever with a malicious certificate, causing a denial of service.
recommended_fix: Upgrade OpenSSL to the patched version provided by the distribution's package manager.

title: Cisco IOS XE Web UI Privilege Escalation
description: A vulnerability in the web UI feature of Cisco IOS XE Software could allow an unauthenticated attacker to create an account with privilege level 15 access.
recommended_fix: Disable the HTTP/HTTPS server feature on internet-facing devices or apply the vendor-provided fix per Cisco's advisory.

title: Device Exposes Telnet Service
description: Device has an open Telnet (port 23) service, which transmits credentials in cleartext and is disabled-by-default on hardened builds.
recommended_fix: Disable Telnet and use the device's encrypted management protocol (SSH/HTTPS) instead.

title: Unauthenticated Access to Management Interface
description: The device's web management interface is reachable without authentication, allowing configuration changes by any network-adjacent host.
recommended_fix: Enable authentication on the management interface and restrict access to an OT management VLAN.

title: Outdated OS Version
description: Device is running an iOS version 3 major releases behind current, missing several security patches.
recommended_fix: Prompt user / enforce MDM compliance policy to update iOS to the current release.

title: Internet-facing RDP discovered on Windows bastion host
description: Weekly external attack-surface sweep found TCP/3389 (RDP) reachable from the internet, outside the approved jump-host allowlist. RDP exposure is a top initial-access vector for ransomware affiliates.
recommended_fix: Restrict RDP to the VPN/jump-host network range via host firewall/NSG rule, and enforce NLA + MFA for any remaining external RDP access.

title: OpenSSH regression allows authentication bypass under non-default config
description: Vendor advisory flags a regression in OpenSSH server affecting hosts with a specific PAM configuration, potentially allowing authentication to be bypassed. Confirmed present on one internal Linux host during config audit.
recommended_fix: Upgrade OpenSSH to the vendor-patched version immediately; this host handles internal authentication traffic.
